game_concept: A survival strategy set in Coastal Port – Storm Breakwater, a breakwater in a storm: the shipwright must handle storm gulls while practicing conditionals (if / elif / else). Core idea – Else Escape: Handle both branches of if/else: attack one kind of storm gulls, dodge the other.
theme: Coastal Port – Storm Breakwater: a breakwater in a storm
core_gameplay_loop: Construct a solution, execute it, inspect actual state and outputs, then revise until all mission goals pass.
player_objective: Arithmetic procedures: double every value. Match all 3 streams; preserve their order. Dataset 7, operand 13.
controls: Edit both node programs. IN reads the upstream queue; OUT sends to the next node. Step advances one cycle; Run checks every stream.
win_condition: The executed solution satisfies every output and world-state check.
lose_condition: The available unsuccessful execution checks are exhausted.
assets_style: Shared Kenney CC0 tile and audio assets with deterministic Canvas layouts; assets are not duplicated per game.
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Else Escape' (Week 3 slot 2), mission type 'Survival Siege', and setting 'Storm Breakwater'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Coastal Port
region.mood: sea-shanty accordion with wave and gull ambience

tutorial: Read the objective, fixtures and command reference.
Build the circuit or route, or edit the node/adventure program.
Use Step to inspect state; Run checks the real outputs and goals.
Revise errors before using the remaining execution checks.
source_player_objective: Protect the lighthouse lamp from storm gulls in Storm Breakwater: keep the hero_hp meter above zero by applying the concept correctly until the 39-second timer ends.
source_lose_condition: hero_hp drops to 0, or lives reach 0, before the 39-second timer ends.
hint: Follow the input through each operation. Compare every output, including negative inputs.
